cross_references.note: §1401 authentication (Layer 1 gate) is prerequisite. §1402 altered document burden (Layer 2 gate) applies after authentication threshold is met. Both must be cleared.
§1401(b): authentication required before secondary evidence of writing's content may be admitted. §1521 secondary evidence rule cannot be invoked without first satisfying §1401.

Authentication of expert-produced documents (Dr. Wiita evaluation) requires both: §1400 (is this the court-ordered evaluation?) AND §720 (is Dr. Wiita qualified to produce it?). Both standards apply to the same document simultaneously.

MC-350 absence analysis: §1400 authentication of a court-ordered evaluation requires the document to be what it claims (a court-ordered evaluation under PC §1368). Without MC-350, the authentication chain for 'court-ordered' status is broken.

Authentication (§§1400-1401) is required before hearsay exception (§1271) can be invoked. Authentication addresses the document's identity; §1271 addresses whether its hearsay content is admissible. Both required for business records.
